title: FOOD-004K — First real food prototype capture preparation
scope: Local owner decision specification and blank operational worksheet only; no actual prototype-domain record or canonical food data.

ownerDecision.technicalFoundation: Standalone frozen gnocchi is the first technical prototype; former FOOD-1 is a temporary decision label, not a canonical ID.
ownerDecision.commercialFollowOn: After foundation validation, develop a prepared gnocchi meal with owner-selected sauce and vegetables; former FOOD-3 is not a canonical ID.
ownerDecision.standaloneCommercialRole: Secondary/add-on standalone offer hypothesis if customers want it; no offer created.
ownerDecision.marketTestHypothesis: MARKET TEST HYPOTHESIS — NOT VALIDATED DEMAND: sample/market the complete prepared meal in its intended context; potentially offer standalone frozen gnocchi separately. No forecast, approved menu, sampling logistics or commercial activation.

productionBaseline: FOOD-004E established zero products, recipes, presentations, serving offers and unpublished/published publications. No production access in this slice.

captureMapping.inputs: Ordered actual ingredientName and positive finite initial grams with unique run-local key; preserve initial measurements. No assumed ingredient list.
captureMapping.method: Ordered actual actions; measured time/temperature, equipment and results may be retained in step text. No prescribed cooking procedure.
captureMapping.adjustments: Ordered process text or mass add/remove with positive measured grams and exactly one known inputKey or adjustment-only ingredientName. Method position and reason belong in text. Unmeasured events remain observations/process notes, never fabricated numeric adjustments.
captureMapping.yield: Actual measured finished usable yield maps to finishedYieldGrams. Identify measurement state and exclusions in observations. Never infer yield from inputs or piece count.
captureMapping.observations: Category/text observations support quality, freezing/storage, sample masses, piece count and loss/waste. No new structured mass-balance, sample, portion or packaging domain.
captureMapping.provenance: Founder-measured sourceReference required for later capture; optional occurredOn date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Worksheet time/source notes are supporting evidence, not added domain fields.
captureMapping.references: Context-free captures are supported. Omit recipe/product references and recipeIngredientIndex until exact validated snapshots exist. A later domain capture requires its own capture ID; none is assigned here.
captureMapping.bounds: Up to 128 inputs, method steps, adjustments and observations each; inputs/method nonempty. Positive finite gram values at most MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; fractional grams retained. Keys/categories 128 characters, ingredient names 256, step/adjustment/observation text 2000, sourceReference 512. Blank worksheet fields are not valid domain data.

handoff.evidence: Actual names/grams, ordered method, adjustments, finished usable yield, available freezing/storage and quality observations, founder provenance and explicit owner run decision; optional photos/notes/test labels.
handoff.repeatability: A repeat batch can check formulation, yield, method and freezing consistency. No arbitrary run count or statistical threshold; owner decides readiness.
handoff.canonicalization: Separate future authorization and owner review required. FOOD-003B recipe formulation must match an exact FOOD-001 recipe draft id/version, with deliberate ordered ingredient-index/gram composition, internal method and yieldGrams; no automatic summing/promoting of prototype events.
handoff.componentReuse: Future validated gnocchi may be deliberately represented as an exact direct-ingredient component version referenced by a meal recipe with grams. FOOD-003B does not allow recipe-as-component references or nested components; do not automatically convert or duplicate formulations.
handoff.preparedMealGaps: Sauce and vegetables unselected; sauce recipe, vegetable preparation, complete-meal formulation, meal portion, package/SKU, price and serving offer do not exist. Public description is not approved. These require separate decisions/evidence.

validation: Ingredient-neutral blank fields and no invented IDs or measurements
Whitespace and complete final change review
operations: Preparation authorized no code, actual capture/fixture/data record, staging, commit, push, D1/KV/Cloudflare/OAuth access, deployment or traffic/DNS change. Subsequent owner closure authorization permits local review/corrections and exact staging of these two documents only; commit/push and production actions remain unauthorized.
